content:
- Model consistently overestimates prices, especially in the early part of the forecast horizon (first 5–10 days).
- Forecasts tend to peak too early and then drop too sharply, missing sustained upward momentum.
- Overshoots after sharp price spikes (e.g., 75+ → 80+) are common, leading to overcorrection downward.
- Mean reversion is underpredicted — model fails to anticipate price pullback after peaks.
- Forecast horizon 30d shows persistent bias toward higher values, suggesting model lacks downward adjustment mechanism.
- Lagged price movements (e.g., 10–15 day lag) are not adequately captured, leading to delayed reaction to true trend shifts.
- Model underestimates volatility in mid-to-late horizon, especially when true price moves sharply downward after peak.
